name: mdcp-monorepo
description: MDCP — documentation system Agent Skill (MarkDown Context Protocol)

scripts.test: pnpm -r run test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/**/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @bwilliamson/mdcp-core run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @bwilliamson/mdcp-cli run test:coverage
scripts.vale:sync: mkdir -p examples/sample-guides/styles docs/styles && (cd examples/sample-guides && vale sync) && (cd docs && vale sync) && rm -rf docs/styles/MDCP docs/styles/MDCP-PandocId docs/styles/MDCP-Xref examples/sample-guides/styles/MDCP examples/sample-guides/styles/MDCP-PandocId examples/sample-guides/styles/MDCP-Xref && ln -sfn ../../packages/mdcp-presets/vale/MDCP docs/styles/MDCP && ln -sfn ../vale-local/MDCP-PandocId docs/styles/MDCP-PandocId && ln -sfn ../../../packages/mdcp-presets/vale/MDCP examples/sample-guides/styles/MDCP && ln -sfn ../../../docs/vale-local/MDCP-PandocId examples/sample-guides/styles/MDCP-PandocId
scripts.prepare:docs: pnpm run verify:peers && pnpm run vale:sync
scripts.docs:check:repo: pnpm run docs:lint:changeset-links && node packages/mdcp-cli/dist/cli.js check --config docs/mdcp.config.json --docs-root docs --require-lint --require-vale
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run docs:check:repo && pnpm run docs:check:examples
scripts.presentation:render: pnpm run presentation:compile && slidev build presentations/la-devops-2026.md --out ../build/presentations/dist
scripts.presentation:render:pdf: pnpm run presentation:compile && slidev export presentations/la-devops-2026.md --output build/presentations/la-devops-2026.pdf
scripts.presentation:verify: pnpm run presentation:compile && slidev export presentations/la-devops-2026.md --format png --output .tmp/slides/
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run skill:validate && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.skill:validate: node scripts/lint-skill-frontmatter.mjs && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-arch-oss-library && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-arch-product-docs-site && skills-ref validate ./skills/mdcp-arch-gtm
scripts.docs:compile: pnpm run docs:compile:repo && pnpm run docs:compile:examples
scripts.site:prepare: pnpm run build && pnpm run docs:compile:repo
scripts.site:dev: pnpm run site:prepare && pnpm --filter @bwilliamson/mdcp-site run dev
scripts.site:build: pnpm run site:prepare && pnpm --filter @bwilliamson/mdcp-site run build:site
